bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W94: Visual QA And Duplicate Drawer Cleanup. Use the W93 compressed UI to run a visual and state smoke focused on duplicate drawer roots/buttons, drawer width and positioning, first-viewport readability, Plan/Review/Run/Trace screenshots, Tampermonkey duplicate install detection, and one active IDB root guarantee. Fix any layout or duplicate-render defects without changing W92 state authority or DCC handoff boundaries. Preserve no IDB writes, no SuiteScript invocation, no transaction writes, hosted resolver optional until remoteSmokeExecuted=true, notes story-only, consultant confirmation required, and DCC ownership of object generation. Output visual QA results, duplicate-root guard if needed, screenshots checklist, validator gates, W94 report, and best next Codex prompt.
